convert-jeffresc report
=======================

Every converted object adopts the provider or application JeffResc created (managementPolicy: Adopt).
Adoption writes only the fields in the spec: a field JeffResc left unset (it applied its own
default) is left unset here, so the live value stays. Before turning dryRun off, read each
object's Ready condition (reason AdoptionDryRun lists `field: old -> new`) and edit the spec
until the only listed changes are ones you intend.

AuthentikApplication authentik-operator-system/gitlab
  files: authentikoauthprovider-gitlab-provider.yaml, authentikapplication-gitlab.yaml
  notes:
    - Secret gitlab-oidc-credentials is rendered as gitlab-oidc-credentials-v2 alongside the old one: compare, then point consumers at it
    - JeffResc labels its Secret goauthentik.io/application=<name>; this operator does not set that label

AuthentikCredentialsTemplates (cluster-scoped; a platform admin applies them)
  jeffresc-a4704637: namespaces authentik-operator-system

Adoption gate: these objects use the operator's default connection, where Adopt is refused
(reason AdoptionNotAllowed) unless the operator admin allows their namespaces. Set the flag
--default-connection-adoption-namespace-selector, or the Helm value
adoption.defaultConnectionNamespaceSelector, to:
  kubernetes.io/metadata.name in (authentik-operator-system)

Adopt mode: a missing match target is reported as AdoptionTargetNotFound and nothing is
created. Once every app is migrated and SSO login is verified, leave adopt mode: remove
managementPolicy, match and dryRun from every converted provider and application (final
runbook step in docs/migration-from-jeffresc.md).
